items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I only heard him at this session but his sound is very good. And ... D. De De Pair, very good.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think he's the best. But I only heard him at this session but his sound is very good. And Richard I think is very good too. I like him very much. And D. De De Pair, very good. What is this guy? There isn't too many good musicians around the world.
What about saxophones? Like any of them?
